verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure almost exactly: the hierarchy is clean, the left column and chips are aligned, and the CTA stands clear. Its only issue is that the peach circle now sits as a full disc behind the CTA, which makes the right side feel a little heavy. B is oversized and cramped. The two-line headline is huge and almost touches the flavour chips. The chips are in reverse order and their tiny text is jammed into the lower-right corner. The subcopy is moved above the button and pushed against the top edge, and the oversized CTA competes with the headline.
